test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-II Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2025)
subject: general
question: EFHE is related to IJLI in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, IJLI is related to MNPM. To which of the given options is PQSP related, following the same logic?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Each letter of the word is moved **+4 positions forward** in the English alphabet.

EFHE is related to IJLI :

 
 E(5) 
• +4 I(9) F(6) 
• +4 J(10) H(8) 
• +4 L(12) E(5) 
• +4 I(9) 

And,

IJLI is related to MNPM :

 
 I(9) 
• +4 M(13) J(10) 
• +4 N(14) L(12) 
• +4 P(16) I(9) 
• +4 M(13) 

Similarly, PQSP is related to :

 
 P(16) 
• +4 T(20) Q(17) 
• +4 U(21) S(19) 
• +4 W(23) P(16) 
• +4 T(20) 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
